facts_source: https://oxygenforest.io (read 2026-10-23). Use ONLY these facts; never invent numbers.

facts.sizes: 2,057 sq yd and 3,630 sq yd estates (3,630 has reserve-forest views on the boundary)
facts.price: Starting from ₹70 lakhs (indicative; full price sheet on WhatsApp)
facts.forest: 25,000 acres of protected forest around the community
facts.plantation: 450+ fruit and timber trees per estate, permaculture master plan
facts.managed_farming: A resident farm team plants, waters, prunes and harvests all seven days, whether you visit every Saturday or twice a year

facts.farmhouse: Space for a farmhouse within the plan
facts.air: The city averages PM2.5 near 50; the forest does not
facts.distance: About 2 hours / 130 km from Hyderabad; 92 km from Medchal; 56 km from Nizamabad; railway station 7 km
facts.legal: Registered forest estate with clear title; documents shared before you commit, verify with your own advocate
facts.resale: Registered land with clear title resells like any land
facts.owner_revenue: Owner revenue-stream plans are revealed only to the 132 owners after the community closes (tease only, no details)
facts.on_site: Real places to show: the dirt track, farm mornings, the pottery shed, seed to table, swales at work, the pond, estate farmhouses
facts.visits: Hosted site visits Saturday and Sunday only, pre-booked, complimentary for serious buyers, no pressure; video walkthrough on WhatsApp for NRIs
facts.urgency: Bookings close in the next 30 days
